name: token-counter
description: Independently tokenize your Codex session history and report cached vs uncached input as a local HTML dashboard.

interface.shortDescription: See where your context window actually goes
interface.longDescription: Re-tokenizes Codex rollout logs locally with a vendored o200k_base vocabulary instead of trusting reported aggregates, attributes every token to a category (system prompt, tool output, user message, reasoning), measures cached against uncached input from the canonical usage ledger, and renders a self-contained HTML dashboard. Raw token counts only: no pricing, no rate-limit translation. Nothing is intercepted at runtime and nothing leaves the machine.
defaultPrompt: Build me a token report for all my Codex sessions
Where is my context window actually going?
Which sessions waste the most tokens on resent tool output?
